title: Electric Circuit Lab

serves.summary: The learner strings wires between a battery, a knife switch and one or two bulbs so the switch turns every bulb on and off, repairs a bulb wired to only one contact, and removes a wire that bypasses the switch, which shows that current needs one complete loop through each bulb and that a switch works by opening and closing that loop.

request.objective: Wire a battery, switch and bulb into one complete loop so the switch turns the bulb on and off: build it, repair a bulb wired to one contact, remove a wire that bypasses the switch, and put two bulbs in one loop. (4-PS3-2)

problems.ask: Wire the battery, switch and bulb so the switch turns the bulb on and off. Then turn it on.
problems.goal: Battery + to the switch, the switch to one bulb contact, the other bulb contact to battery −, blade closed. Two wires that reach the bulb's side contact only leave the bulb dark.

wires: switch post B to bulb side contact
switch post B to bulb side contact

problems.ask: Someone wired this circuit, but the bulb will not light. Fix it so the switch turns the bulb on and off, then turn it on.
problems.goal: The wire from the side contact to battery − is cut and the bottom contact is wired to battery − instead; blade closed. Closing the switch on the bench as wired makes the battery hot.

wires: switch post B to bulb side contact
switch post B to bulb side contact
switch post B to bulb side contact

problems.ask: This bulb stays on even when the switch is open. Fix it so the switch turns the bulb on and off, then turn it on.
problems.goal: The wire jumped from switch post A to post B is cut and the blade is closed. Closing the blade with that wire left in lights the bulb, but the switch does nothing.

wires: switch post A to switch post B
switch post B to bulb side contact
switch post B to bulb side contact
switch post A to switch post B
switch post B to bulb side contact

problems.ask: Wire both bulbs so one switch turns them both on and off. Then turn them on.
problems.goal: One loop: battery +, the switch, in and out of the first bulb, in and out of the second bulb, battery −; blade closed. A loop through the first bulb only leaves the second dark.

wires: switch post B to first bulb side contact
first bulb bottom contact to second bulb side contact
second bulb bottom contact to battery −
switch post B to first bulb side contact
first bulb bottom contact to battery −
second bulb side contact to first bulb side contact
